ud4.8:10.1: “Sir, these days when the people of Sāvatthī see the mendicants they abuse and insult them with rude, harsh words:
ud4.8:10.2: ‘Shameless are these ascetics who follow the Sakyan, immoral, wicked. They are liars and unchaste.
ud4.8:10.3: Sure, they claim to be of principled and moral conduct, to be chaste, truthful, ethical, and of good character.
ud4.8:10.4: But they have no asceticism, no spirituality.
ud4.8:10.5: Asceticism and spirituality are lost to them!
ud4.8:10.6: Where is their asceticism, where their spirituality?
ud4.8:10.7: They have abandoned asceticism and spirituality!
ud4.8:10.8: How on earth can a man, having done a man’s business, kill a woman!’”
ud4.8:14.2: as does one who denies what they did.
ud4.8:14.3: Both are equal in the hereafter,
